items.label: Hanging weight per head
items.source: Worked example used throughout the wiki (750 lb hanging steer)
items.note: Drives the per-pound cutting fee.

items.label: Harvest (farm-call kill) fee
items.source: Backyard Butchery OK ($100-150); Beaverhead Meats MT ($75-125)
items.note: Beaverhead figure is 2026.

items.label: Mileage charge (average)
items.source: Assumed average; Backyard Butchery charges $2.65/mile one way
items.note: Depends on route density and head per farm visit.

items.label: Cut, vac-pack, label
items.note: Price matters more than equipment cost (Section 8.2).

items.label: Extras (aging, SRM, offal haul-off) average
items.source: Blended average; T&E $25/head/week aging, $50 over-30-month; Backyard Butchery $100 offal haul-off
items.note: Mix of customers taking extras is assumed.

items.label: Employee wage
items.source: BLS OEWS, Virginia butchers and meat cutters mean wage
items.note: May 2025 estimate. Owner is unpaid in the model.

items.label: Payroll burden (taxes, benefits)
items.note: Workers comp is modelled separately below.

items.label: Workers comp rate, NCCI 2081 Butchering
items.note: Iowa 2009 rate stands in for Virginia; get an agent quote.

items.label: Packaging & supplies
items.note: Vac-seal bags, labels, boxes, knives, sanitizer.

items.label: Renderer, SRM, hides
items.note: Darling Ingredients fees and minimums are unknown.

items.label: Fuel & vehicle repair per harvest day
items.source: Derived from Nevada study ($230/day for 2 units)
items.note: Old and out-of-region.

items.label: Head per harvest day
items.source: Assumption; harvest capacity is ~7 beef per person-day (NMPAN/Lorentz 2010)
items.note: Sets the number of harvest days and so fuel cost.

items.label: Cooler utilities (power, water)
items.note: About $600/month.

items.label: Sewer base charge
items.note: Rounded to $600/yr.

items.label: Wash water to sewer per head
items.note: Cooler-dock wash-down only; farm kills use an onboard tank.

items.label: Sewer volume charge
items.note: Top of range. High-strength surcharge not modelled.

items.label: Insurance (liability, auto, property)
items.source: CISA MA cut-shop template ($9,600/yr on ~$226k revenue)

items.label: Cooler site lease
items.note: Land purchase not modelled.

items.label: Mobile kill-and-cut unit
items.note: Equipment options may be extra. Kill-only trailer + cut-room trailer is roughly $192k.

items.label: Tow tractor, used

items.source: Assumption: CUP/engineering, permits, 2-3 months operating cash
